rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a temporary break in a journey or stay between travel segments.

example.english: This trip to Japan will have a one-night stopover in Seoul.
example.traditional: 今次去日本會喺首爾中途停留一晚。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 heoi3 jat6 bun2 wui5 hai2 sau2 ji5 zung1 tou4 ting4 lau4 jat1 maan5

rows.note: Use this when focusing on the stopover place or destination rather than the duration of the stay.

example.english: Paris is the stopover on our trip.
example.traditional: 巴黎係我哋今次旅程嘅中途站。
example.jyutping: baa1 lai4 hai6 ngo5 dei6 gam1 ci3 leoi5 cing4 ge3 zung1 tou4 zaam6

rows.note: Use this for a flight stopover that involves changing planes, not for every kind of stopover.

example.english: Our stopover in Singapore involves changing planes before we fly to Sydney.
example.traditional: 我哋喺新加坡轉機，先至飛得去悉尼。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 san1 gaa1 bo1 zyun3 gei1 sin1 zi3 fei1 dak1 heoi3 sik1 nei4
